binding_rule: At authorized launch copy this file to preregistration.v1.json, change schema to tnp-estimated-noise/preregistration-v1 and state to FROZEN, and fill only the four launch_binding values from observed facts. Science and its digest must remain identical. Never use null bindings to execute. Freeze commit SHA/server PR anchor and later source/seed pins live in subsequent receipts, avoiding self-hashes.

analysis.aggregation: For each law/noise/method/budget cell: expected=16, interpretable denominator, counts, all 16 block values, and exponent-stratified counts with expected=4. Paired comparisons report both rejection->nonrejection and nonrejection->rejection counts plus paired-block denominator. Estimate/epsilon and bound widths report median,min,max with explicit n. Counts may also be shown /16; no population intervals or p-values.
analysis.coverage_dependence: Uniform normalized calibration banks are matched across conditions. Do not count copies at different scales/laws as independent calibration-coverage trials. Present all condition results; summarize distinct block coverage vectors at each budget, retaining any rounding-induced discrepancies.
analysis.interpretation: Ideal analytic coverage is model-conditional mathematics; observed coverage/detection counts are finite designed-suite outcomes. Nonrejection does not prove adequacy or diagnose real-data causes.
no_adaptive_rules: No tuning alpha, budgets, beta, epsilon, sample count, thresholds or rank penalty.
No exclusions, seed replacements or extra scientific runs.
No requirement for monotone recognition, improved performance, zero false rejection or observed 95 percent coverage.
per_dataset: all seven family and rank1 decisions
structural match and credit by rule
analysis.primary: At each of the three noise levels, compare upper95/64 with point/64 and known-noise reference using paired block rejection changes, adequate-control rejection and curved recognition. No data-dependent pooling or winning-method selection.
analysis.secondary: Repeat the prespecified comparisons for m=16,256; report within-block budget changes, scale ratios, bound coverage and widths. Do not replace primary analysis with a favorable secondary budget.

assumptions: Exact positive features; adequate truth is in the exhaustively enumerated family.
Independent centered Uniform[-epsilon,epsilon] log errors with a common scale within each dataset and its calibration pairs.
Same clean response for both measurements in a calibration pair; no drift or pair correlation.
Calibration, train, validation and heldout streams separate within each block; intentional matching across six conditions and nested budgets disclosed.
claim_scope.historical_claim: Historical wrong stable selections may recover the base monomial while omitting curvature; they are not automatically wrong base-exponent selections.
claim_scope.known_information: Designer knows historical Margin1 results, generator families, scale grid and formulas. No prospective scientific seed or target data exists during preparation. Uniform-distribution shape remains specified; only its scale is hidden from operational workers.
nonclaims: Unknown noise distribution or arbitrary real-data performance.
A calibrated population detection rate from sixteen blocks.
Family acceptance proves the family or selected formula true.
A 95 percent posterior probability of formula correctness.
Simultaneous 95 percent coverage over budgets, blocks or study.
Bounds on rank-1 selection error or physical-law discovery.
External-engine comparison, PySR qualification, empirical gravity evidence, formal Lean proof or independent replication.
claim_scope.primary: A prospective, fixed, synthetic mechanism study of estimated-noise family rejection, with an analytic conditional error bound. Completion is independent of detector performance.

design.sample_size_rationale: A bounded balanced extension from four to sixteen blocks, not a power calculation or high-precision tail-rate estimation. No data-dependent expansion.
design.unit: Block is the independent unit; four independently seeded blocks per deterministic exponent stratum. Conditions, paired methods, shared calibration noise and nested prefixes are dependent. The 672 assessments are not independent replicates.

dispositions.COMPLETE: All 96 datasets have full calibrated estimates, complete candidate inventories, six sealed operational assessments, reference assessment, heldout evaluation and required integrity checks. Detector performance irrelevant.
dispositions.FAIL: Established custody, leakage, frozen-contract, numeric allowance, unsupported-credit or evidence-integrity violation; takes precedence even if other evidence is missing.
dispositions.NO_GO: Sound accounted prerequisite/capability failure with zero fully interpretable datasets.
dispositions.PARTIAL: Sound evidence for 1..95 fully interpretable datasets with every other expected record explicitly accounted for; no hidden exclusion.
dispositions.UNRESOLVED: Necessary evidence missing/conflicting so integrity or interpretation cannot be established; no established violation superseding it.
dispositions.evidence_axis: evidence_integrity PASS/FAIL/UNRESOLVED separate from study disposition; adverse scientifically valid outcomes can have PASS integrity.
dispositions.fully_interpretable: All six operational rules plus reference for a dataset evaluable; partial method records remain visible but do not count as a complete dataset.
dispositions.operational_axis: Operational failures stored as their own immutable events/routes; a reporting failure after scientific completion does not overwrite raw science.

estimation.analytic_derivation: Under iid uniform errors, F(t)=P(abs(e1-e2)/(2*epsilon)<=t)=2*t-t*t, 0<=t<=1. P(M/(2*epsilon)<q_m)=F(q_m)**m=alpha. Thus ideal upper coverage is 1-alpha for epsilon>0. Padded upper is conservative if observed maximum understates the ideal maximum by no more than the fixed pad.
estimation.calibration_seal: Compute all six estimates and thresholds from calibration alone, seal and commit before any discovery evaluation. No residual-based update or selection of a budget.
estimation.false_rejection_derivation: For adequate truth, the true-class fitted log-intercept shifts by mean training noise; each validation residual <=2*epsilon. Conditional on upper>=epsilon, the exhaustive family cannot be rejected at 2*upper+delta in exact arithmetic. Therefore false FAMILY rejection is at most alpha marginally per prespecified m, under assumptions and numerical qualification; no guarantee for rank-1 selection or simultaneous study-wide decisions.
estimation.pad_meaning: A declared absolute log-difference rounding allowance, not estimated physical noise. Record ideal and padded bounds separately; decisions use padded bound. Preflight and post-reveal numerical checks must validate the allowance; never enlarge it after seeing scientific outcomes.
estimation.zero_handling: Fixtures only: if all observed differences vanish, point=0 and implemented_upper=pad/(2*q_m). Do not infer true epsilon=0. Empty/missing pairs, nonpositive/nonfinite/bool responses, duplicate pair IDs or wrong prefix lengths fail validation; do not replace with zeros.

execution_controls.ci: New offline guard reached through ordinary unittest discovery; workflow unchanged. Focused local affected checks plus one final full Python suite at exact head (CI may supply it) and both existing protected CI jobs. Reuse unchanged evidence; no unrelated local Lean run or old benchmark campaign.
execution_controls.environment: CPython 3.12, Python standard library and accepted internal modules; no external engine, new environment stack or native dependency.
execution_controls.failure_budget: No scientific retries or replacement seeds. Stop the scientific pipeline at first stage failure; retain all completed and partial artifacts and mark unrun records NOT_EXECUTED. Pre-seed engineering fixes allowed with retained failed preflight and full affected-boundary requalification. After seed, deterministic transport/readback retries can only transfer existing identical bytes, never regenerate or refit. Any post-outcome verifier correction is detached, source-pinned, read-only and preserves the original failure.
execution_controls.mutation_acceptance: All ten mutations killed by designated semantic assertions on deterministic fixtures; baseline and a semantically equivalent control survive. Crashes before intended assertion are failed calibration, not kills. No prospective target seed used.
mutations: M1 use standard deviation as half-width.
M2 replace upper quantile lower tail alpha with 1-alpha.
M3 drop prescribed numeric pad in the primary rule.
M4 use true epsilon or fit residuals as estimator input.
M5 select calibration pairs by magnitude rather than fixed prefix.
M6 make family assessment from rank1 instead of family minimum.
M8 use heldout rows in estimation, ranking or coefficient fit.
M9 award structural credit to stable curved-law approximation.
M10 drop/relabel failed or missing records to COMPLETE.
execution_controls.read_boundaries: Calibration worker gets anonymous pairs only. Discovery worker gets anonymous train/validation payload and primary estimated policy only. Both run staged with explicit dependency inventories and fresh-cache receipts; evaluator/generator/seed/oracle/heldout/old results unavailable. Trusted operator isolation, not hostile-code/OS sandbox security.
execution_controls.scope: Only new package-local modules/tests/artifacts/Notes. Existing tracked repository files, workflows, interpreter pins and historical artifacts byte-identical.
execution_controls.source_pins: Pin exact committed source bytes used, checked before execution and against receipts. Later read-only verification reads committed source at source_sha, not an indefinite equality constraint on future shared working-tree files. Scientific artifacts/used-source epochs immutable; no new repository-wide live-source freeze.
tests: Independent quantile/moment fixtures and numeric pads.
Exact complete five-class inventory and independent arithmetic.
Calibration-only input schema and forbidden-source/heldout poison probes.
Primary policy derives from sealed upper95/64, never true epsilon or candidate residuals.
Prefix nesting, independent streams, anonymization and preserved matching.
Equality, null/zero distinctions and malformed numeric rejection.
No exact structural credit for omitted curvature.
All disposition branches derived from evidence; FAIL precedence.
Chronology/hash tamper and current receipt/cache read semantics.

generation.anonymous_ids: Enumerate tuples (b,condition_index,noise_index) in that order. Sort tuples by SHA256(UTF8(seed+":estimated-noise1:anon:"+str(b)+":"+str(condition_index)+":"+str(noise_index))), tie by tuple. Assign d001..d096. Keep mapping private until reveal. Public labels never encode law/noise/stratum.
generation.block_seed: SHA256(UTF8(seed + ":estimated-noise1:block:" + str(b))) as lowercase hex; b=0..15.
generation.calibration_measurement: Retain actual positive response_1,response_2 for every pair, with pair_id and identical features. Estimator input strips features and includes only pair_id,response_1,response_2. Differences are computed from observed log responses, never generator errors or clean values.
generation.calibration_streams: Separate calibration:inputs draws x,t,z offsets per pair, using base ranges. calibration:noise:1 and calibration:noise:2 each draw one normalized Uniform[-1,1] error per pair. Pair members share exact features/clean signal; response values are independently perturbed. Reuse this separate bank across the six conditions. Budgets use the first m pairs in frozen generation order, never sorted or selected.
generation.discovery_streams: For split in train,validation,heldout: split+":inputs" draws x,t,z offsets per row; split+":noise" draws one normalized Uniform[-1,1] error per row. Features exp(center+offset). Generate each block bank once and reuse across both laws and all three scales.
generation.group_label: g0 on every discovery row; preserve inherited group diagnostics as diagnostics only.
generation.law: log_y_clean = log(k) + log(x) - 2*log(t) + p*log(z) + beta*log(z)**2; y=exp(log_y_clean+epsilon*u)
generation.law_draw_order: Stream(child,"law"): log coefficient, x center, t center, z center, in that order; even the zero-width z center consumes a draw. coefficient=exp(log coefficient).
generation.master_seed: One secrets.token_hex(32), generated only after source/environment/fixture preflight is committed. Never replace. Scientific seed is not an engineering fixture seed.
generation.proof_of_curved_nonmembership: Every permitted monomial is affine in log(z) at fixed x,t; curved truth has second derivative 2*0.01. No curvature alias is supplied.
generation.same_epoch_replay: After reveal, explicit replay may reproduce this committed seed for deterministic reproducibility only; not new evidence. No historical benchmark regeneration.
generation.seed_commitment: SHA256(UTF8("estimated-noise1:" + seed)); publish sole-file seed commitment and verify remote head before any target generation.
generation.stream_algorithm: Reuse pinned symbolic_suite_worlds.Stream: counter starts 0; H=SHA256(UTF8(child+":"+name+":"+str(counter))); u64=int.from_bytes(H[:8],"big")/2**64; uniform(lo,hi)=lo+(hi-lo)*u64; increment after draw. Ideal continuous statements are analytical, not claims that the finite PRNG is truly continuous.

grammar.coefficient_fit: For each class, mean training [log(target)-log(monomial)]. Never refit on validation/heldout/calibration. Full ranking inventory required.
grammar.engine: Pinned symbolic_suite_engine.discover through existing staged runner; acceptance_validation_rmse set to primary upper95 m=64 threshold. Fresh wrapper computes secondary decisions from same sealed ranking.
grammar.family: Positive coefficient times dimensionally admissible monomials in x,t,z; five canonical signatures x^1*t^-2*z^j for j=-2,-1,0,1,2. Omit z from signature when j=0.
grammar.fits: 96 discovery evaluations of five principal candidate classes (480 principal coefficient fits). Inherited group diagnostic refits are recorded separately and do not become selections. No refit for alternate thresholds.
grammar.preflight_invariant: Changing threshold on engineering fixtures must leave all candidate expressions, coefficients, scores and ranking unchanged; threshold-dependent labels, input digests and ablation decisions may change. If this fails, stop before scientific seed.
grammar.ranking: validation log RMSE + 0.001 * expanded exponent L1 complexity; ties by complexity then canonical class ID.

numerical_qualification.arithmetic: CPython 3.12 binary64 production with math.fsum; JSON disallows NaN/Infinity, booleans as numbers and duplicate keys. Frozen interpreter patch/platform recorded at preflight; no version change afterwards.
numerical_qualification.failure: If the declared numerical allowance is violated, retain results and report FAIL for established contract violation or UNRESOLVED for unresolved numerical evidence; no pad inflation, reroll or favorable post-hoc recalibration.
numerical_qualification.independent_reference: decimal localcontext precision=80, using Decimal.from_float on stored binary64 inputs, Decimal.ln/exp for independent checks; never import the production estimator into its independent oracle.
numerical_qualification.post_reveal: Recompute every calibration observed-log difference at 80-digit precision; compare production difference and intended epsilon*(u1-u2) from revealed generator draws within 1e-12. Confirm any numerical underestimation of the ideal upper is covered by the fixed pad; compare production all-candidate metrics to independent calculation within 1e-10. Check adequate true-class residuals<=2*epsilon+1e-10. These checks diagnose numeric integrity; they never change sealed decisions.
numerical_qualification.preflight: Deterministic engineering fixtures include every scientific parameter corner, zero/tiny error, equal/repeated differences, alternate alpha/budgets and threshold equality. Assert quantile inversion, difference and bound error allowances, safe finite positive observations, all-candidate arithmetic and analytic adequate-member residual inequality.

science.question: How does estimating a bounded uniform log-noise scale from independent replicate pairs change family-inadequacy decisions relative to known noise, and what is the calibration-budget tradeoff?

scoring.approximation: rank1 validation RMSE<=0.04 before reveal; heldout check separately afterwards. Predictive approximation is distinct from adequacy and structural credit.
scoring.family: minimum raw validation RMSE across exactly five eligible classes > T. An absent/incomplete family is capability/integrity failure, never evidence of recognized inadequacy.
scoring.missing: Use null plus explicit stage/reason for undefined metrics, never zero or a fabricated negative result.
scoring.rank1: stable_candidate iff rank1 validation RMSE<=T; otherwise no_stable_law. Rank1 chosen by frozen ranking, not by oracle or family-minimum score.
scoring.reference: After all operational decisions are sealed, compute known-noise labels using true epsilon and exactly the same fitted coefficients. No reference labels or true epsilon available before seal.
scoring.structural_credit: Evaluation only, per method/budget/reference: adequate truth AND rank1 canonical signature matches truth AND sealed rank1 stable AND max(training,validation,heldout rank1 RMSE)<=that threshold AND abs(coefficient/k-1)<=0.04 AND eligibility/provenance intact. Curved truth always gets false. This is controlled synthetic structural credit, not empirical evidence.
scoring.threshold: T=2*scale+1e-9; scale is point, padded upper or evaluator-only true epsilon. Equality is adequate; strict > means rejection. No fuzzy comparison or tolerance added to scientific cutoffs.
